related_questions.question: Is consent required for vaccines?
related_questions.snippet: There is no Federal requirement for informed consent relating to immunization. For state and local regulations, check with your local or state health department.
related_questions.title: Requirements and Laws | Vaccines & Immunizations - CDC

related_questions.question: Is it legal to ask for proof of vaccination?
related_questions.snippet: Employers are within their rights to require employees to be vaccinated, given the risk that COVID-19 poses to the workforce. Employers can also ask employees to provide proof of vaccination.
related_questions.title: Is it a HIPAA Violation to Ask for Proof of Vaccine Status?

related_questions.question: Can I be forced to get a vaccine?
related_questions.snippet: The government or other authorities can't physically force you to get vaccinated. A vaccine mandate just means that if you don't, businesses, schools, and others can legally stop you from entering the building or using their services if they choose to. Vaccine mandates aren't new.
related_questions.title: Vaccine Mandate: What to Know - WebMD

related_questions.question: Can you ask someone if they are vaccinated?
related_questions.snippet: It is not a violation of HIPAA to ask someone about their vaccination status. The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) restricts doctors and insurance companies from disclosing information about their patients.
related_questions.title: Should I Ask My Friends If They Are Vaccinated? | Johns Hopkins
